title: A Refund Is Not a Rollback
description: An order saga reserves inventory, charges a card and then fails to book delivery. What does compensation mean here?

options.text: A database rollback removes the charge from the provider.
options.explanation: The provider committed a separate action; a local rollback cannot undo it.

options.text: Issue a refund and release inventory through retryable, idempotent actions.
options.explanation: Compensation semantically reverses committed effects, normally in reverse order. A refund may remain visible beside the charge and is not equivalent to never charging.

options.text: Leave inventory held because the payment already succeeded.
options.explanation: That abandons the failed saga with resources still reserved rather than resolving its state.

options.text: Repeat the charge before attempting delivery again.
options.explanation: A new charge is not a compensation and can double-charge the customer.
